title: Nonnegativity of positive power means
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $p>0$, and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Then $M_p(f)\ge0$, where $M_p$ is the extended power mean under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
replaced: For $p>0$ and every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the uniform power mean $M_p(f)=(\E|f|^p)^{1/p}$ is nonnegative.
